welcome.title: Open a collection
welcome.body: Connect to a server in the sidebar, then pick a collection to browse, query and edit its documents.
welcome.palette: Press <kbd>{{shortcut}}</kbd> to jump to any collection or action.

quit.title_one: Quit while an operation is running?
quit.description: Running backups, restores, imports, exports and copies are cancelled first. Backups interrupted this way are marked as such in the history.
